function: Deep-unfolded PWM-BFNet learns penalty, regularization and initialization parameters of an iterative joint design of BS beamforming, RDARS beamforming and mode switching maximizing weighted sum rate. pp. 8-9
system: 16-antenna ULA BS, RDARS of 128 elements (8 connected as distributed antennas, others passive reflecting), 4 single-antenna users, blocked direct links, mmWave, no carrier stated. pp. 4, 10
method: Model-driven deep unfolding of PWM iterations (L = 15); few trainable scalars (penalty, regularization, power split), unsupervised loss of negative weighted sum rate, SGD, offline training. pp. 9-10
data_channel: Custom Rician channels with steering vectors and power-law path loss (exponents 2.2, 2.4); 10,000 simulated realizations for training, 1,000 Monte Carlo trials for testing. pp. 4, 10
test_conditions: Fixed training at Ptot=30 dBm, K=4, N=128, Rician 10, a=8 (or retrained per value); tested at other powers, 2-8 users, 16-512 elements, Rician 2-14, a=4-10. pp. 12-13
baselines: Non-learned only: PWM (own, non-learned), DLRCB-PWM (RCB-BF [17] initialization), fixed-index RDARS, DAS, RIS, STAR-RIS, partitioned RIS; no learned baseline. pp. 10-11
metrics: Weighted sum rate, number of iterations to convergence, runtime in ms, and offline training time of 369.73 s. pp. 10-13
complexity: Table I: PWM-BFNet O(Id'(K(Nt+a)^2+K^2N^2+9N^3)), 5 iterations, 44.83 ms versus PWM 587.88 ms; only 2K+2(Id'+1) trainable scalars. p. 10
q1_support: p. 4: "By considering the general Rician channel model" with its own steering vectors; p. 10 gives its own path-loss exponents 2.2 and 2.4. Custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 12: "the PWM-BFNet trained at K = 4 still remains a high performance for scenarios with different numbers of UEs". Fig. 7 (p. 12) trains at N = 128 and tests 16 to 512 RDARS elements.
q3_support: p. 10: "RDARS PWM: The RDARS-aided system with the PWM algorithm is considered" is the authors' own non-learned algorithm. The other comparisons (DLRCB-PWM, fixed index, DAS, RIS, STAR-RIS, partitioned RIS) are also non-learned; no earlier learned method or standard network is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "The number of iterations and runtime are obtained by averaging over 1,000 Monte Carlo trials" (Table I gives the O() complexity of PWM-BFNet and a runtime of 44.8302 ms, and the text counts its trainable scalars).
q5_support: p. 10: "Similarly, we generate 10,000 channel realizations to train the model-driven network". Data are self-simulated; no code or data link and no public dataset is given.
notes: Included. Deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned. RDARS is a hybrid of reflecting elements and elements switched to connected antennas, so ris is 1 and the area is 3 (BS and RDARS beamforming plus mode switching). The PDF is the accepted author's version from IEEE Xplore. Figs. 5 to 9 legends were read from the page images (pp. 12-13).
